slot.subtopic: Range of a sin + b cos
slot.brief: Find the maximum and minimum of a cos θ + b sin θ and hence solve a given equation has no solution / find range.

stem: For real $\theta$, the range of $\dfrac{8+3\cos\theta-4\sin\theta}{10+3\cos\theta-4\sin\theta}$ is

verdicts.working: Let x=3\cos\theta-4\sin\theta, so x\in[-5,5]. The function (8+x)/(10+x) is increasing since its derivative is 2/(10+x)^2>0. Its endpoint values are 3/5 and 13/15.

working:
$u=3\cos\theta-4\sin\theta\in[-5,5]$
$\dfrac{8+u}{10+u}=1-\dfrac{2}{10+u}$ is increasing for $u\in[-5,5]$
$\min=\dfrac{8-5}{10-5}=\dfrac{3}{5},\qquad \max=\dfrac{8+5}{10+5}=\dfrac{13}{15}$

Independent check: Let x=3\cos\theta-4\sin\theta, so x\in[-5,5]. The function (8+x)/(10+x) is increasing since its derivative is 2/(10+x)^2>0. Its endpoint values are 3/5 and 13/15.
